# Juan Miguel Ruiz - Full-Stack Web Developer

## Overview
Juan Miguel Ruiz is a Full-Stack Web Developer based in Villavicencio, Colombia. He specializes in building fast, scalable, and modern web applications using Vue.js, Nuxt 3, React, and Angular. He offers remote freelance development services to clients worldwide, focusing on high-performance websites, progressive web apps (PWAs), and AI integrations.
